rationale.complete: Round 1 done: assembled table, synthetic validation of the decision rule, per-period verdicts and scorecard, plus an amended frozen confirmatory script; the holdout run needs H03/H04 held-out exports, and H10-H18 estimates are not yet ingested.
rationale.faithfulness: The primary collapse was refuted outright (opposite-sign slopes, loses to regime, era and size rivals out of sample, C = 0, H = 0); only the secondary unfitted mapping P3 and the no-mode-effect P5 hold.
rationale.usefulness: Mostly a warning that 'loop gain' is channel-specific and a cross-method conversion; the post hoc messages-per-LLM-step knob could matter for steering but is selected after the fact and unconfirmed.

one_line: No common loop-gain curve: activity and talk channels move oppositely; Hawkes-to-Ising mapping holds.
